outcome: A static ability's continuous effect applies while its source stays on the battlefield with the ability and stops when it leaves or loses the ability.
An Aura or Equipment's static ability modifies the object it is attached to, and moving it makes the new object modified and the old one not.
A static ability such as an alternative or additional cost or a counter clause applies while its spell is on the stack.
A card with a static ability saying it may or can't be cast or played, or only under a condition, is legal or illegal to cast from hand accordingly.
A static ability reads the current game state and not last known information, so a source that has left its zone no longer applies its effect.
